description: Activate when: user says 'we have a better product but we're losing,' 'they're growing despite less funding,' 'our moat isn't protecting us,' 'the market shifted under us,' 'we just need to hire harder,' or is diagnosing why strong incumbents lose to weaker newcomers, evaluating a market entry, or asking whether a strategy depends too much on specific people. Do NOT activate when: the decision is purely tactical (not strategic), or the context is cooperative/ethical leadership where 'winning configurationally' is the wrong frame. More: deciqai.com/c/momentum-and-form
